audit_name: SHS Build Packet Approval Evidence V1

build_packet_surface.evidence: Route is mounted in AdminRoutes, linked in AdminSidebar, protected by hubAccessControl, and exposes Copy Build Packet plus Download Build Packet .txt.
Source steps feed the active page draft used by the build packet generator; some approval evidence remains manual.
Build packet generator includes client profile, selected package, handoff context, bundle, components, brand application, workflow requirements, QA checklist, Copy, Export, and Save to Project.
QA requires project ID, business name, modules, reports, portals, checklist attachment, 100 percent readiness, and no critical blockers before ClientOps conversion.

present_elements.evidence: SHRV1 packet includes project name, owner, priority, and confidentiality; SHF-Next includes project name and attached project context.
SHF-Next packet includes client name, selected package, stage, client profile, and active handoff details.
SHRV1 includes brand profile draft; SHF-Next includes brand name, logo text, primary/accent colors, tone, and industry language.
SHRV1 packet includes active page route, page name, page type, audience, goal, and status; unified multi-page route export is not present.
SHF-Next packet includes required modules, dashboards, portals, workflows, reports, and permissions; exact code component/file names are not mandatory.
SHRV1 packet includes data binding notes; SHF-Next project validation requires modules, reports, and portals before QA.
SHRV1 packet includes asset rules, but source, rights, and approval evidence are operator-entered and not hard-gated.
SHRV1 packet includes acceptance checklist and screenshot QA; SHF-Next includes QA templates and a QA delivery dashboard.
SHRV1 generated packet includes acceptance checklist text; SHF-Next enforces checklist readiness, but signed acceptance evidence is not durable.
SHRV1 generated packet includes explicit non-goals; SHF-Next includes internal-use warning but no dedicated non-goals section.
SHRV1 supports Copy Build Packet and Download Build Packet .txt; SHF-Next supports Copy, Export, and Save to Project.
SHRV1 packet states do not redesign and includes specification, QA, acceptance, and non-goals; SHF-Next packet includes Codex build instructions.

missing_elements.evidence: Build packet status can be set manually, but there is no approver identity, signature, timestamp, packet version, or immutable ledger.
Raw packet output includes internal SHS implementation instructions and should not be sent directly to clients.
Export exists as local text/copy/download, but not as signed, hashed, versioned, or approval-locked artifact.
QA and ClientOps validation exist, but delivery is still local/manual rather than bound to a durable launch gate.
Components/modules are described at product/system level; exact files to create/reuse are not required in the packet.

missing_elements.element: Mandatory asset source and rights approval
missing_elements.evidence: Asset rules are captured as notes; source, license, approval status, and replacement rules are not enforced.
SHRV1 packet is page-oriented; SHF-Next packet is project-oriented, but no single signed multi-page delivery bundle exists.

approval_evidence: SHRV1 Build Packet route is protected for shs_admin in hubAccessControl.
SHRV1 Build Packet status can be set to Not Started, In Progress, Ready for Review, Approved, or Blocked.
SHRV1 workflow stage statuses can mark packet-adjacent stages as ready, approved, or blocked.
SHRV1 generated packet includes project, page, workflow status, specification, screenshot QA, acceptance checklist, and non-goals.
SHF-Next Development Library can save generated packets to project-local state.
SHF-Next QA + Delivery validates project readiness and critical blockers before ClientOps conversion.
export_evidence: SHRV1 Build Packet supports Copy Build Packet.
SHRV1 Build Packet supports Download Build Packet .txt.
SHF-Next Development Library supports Save to Project.
required_fixes: Add signed build packet approval fields: approver, role, status, timestamp, packet version, and approval notes.
Add immutable packet versioning or export hash before paid launch.
Create a client-safe review export that removes internal methods, QA machinery, prompts, and private implementation notes.
Require component/file-path inventory and reusable component decisions in development-ready packets.
Require asset source, usage rights, approval status, and replacement notes before client review.
Add a hard delivery gate that requires approved packet, complete QA checklist, support tier, handoff guide, launch approval, and no critical blockers.
Create a unified multi-page project packet export for delivery-grade projects.
Persist approval and export evidence beyond local/browser state before paid launch.
go_no_go: GO for supervised private-beta development handoff. WARNING for operator-curated client review only. NO-GO for paid delivery until signed approval, client-safe export, durable evidence, and hard delivery gates are complete.
